description: §19.16.3 rule 4 — `defer` at the top level of a `${ }` logic block (no enclosing function body) is E-DEFER-OUTSIDE-FUNCTION, exactly once; it is never a silently inert statement.
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 4: `defer` SHALL appear only inside a function body; top-level logic is page/module initialisation that the compiler reorders, so there is no single block exit to attach the deferred body to.
